title: Sheds white balls
text: Sheds white balls. Each and every time I wash this couch cover it sheds small white balls from the underneath gripping part that helps to hold it in place. This is so aggravating!! Other than that I Love how it feels!

product_metadata.title: H.VERSAILTEX Thick Velvet Sofa Cover Soft Couch Cover for 3 Cushion Cover Washable Furniture Protector for Dogs Non-Slip Sofa Slipcover Fit Sitting Width Up to 78"(Oversaized Sofa, Taupe)
features: LUXURIOUS VELVET: This H.VERSAILTEX Real Velvet Furniture Protector is incredibly comfortable and visually appealing. The classic quilted box design on ultra-soft, smooth fabric for a lush, comfortable, warm feel. Spruce up your home and make it as rich and luxe as the velvet fabric itself

PERFECT FITTING: This velvet protector is designed to fit most different styles of furnitures. There are 5 measures options (fit the sitting width) : Chair - 23", Recliner - 28", Love Seat - 54", Sofa - 70", Oversized Sofa - 78". And available in multiple rich, complementary color tones that will accentuate any style decor

STAY IN PLACE: Including TWO upgraded 2” wide adjustable elastic straps and the non-slip PVC backing, no matter on leather or fabric furniture, our protector can always secure in place firmly without constant slipping and sliding. There is one strap to wrap around the back of your furniture and one for under the seat cushion

FASHION AND FUNCTIONALITY: Bring a stylish refresh to your furniture to compliment any room setting while shields and protects sofas, loveseats, and chairs from spills, stains, dirt, grime, wear and tear. With Right Side Pockets, keep your books, remotes, eye glasses, mobile phones organized

CARE AND MAINTENANCE: Just toss this piece in the washing machine for effortless upkeep. Separately in cold water on the gentle cycle, do not use bleach. Additionally, before first use we recommend pre-washing the cover. Do not use on furniture treated with additives, cleaners, or conditioners, they may react with the PVC backing and result in damage to your furniture
